comment: Airwindows-inspired custom tape echo for Zoom Multistomp. Uses ctx[3] for a bounded stereo delay line and compact mono spring fallback, a FIR derived from a UAD Galaxy Tape Echo IR, TapeHack-style soft clipping, adjustable wear filtering, measured flutter/wow modulation, and a BPM+division tempo workflow. The closer desktop spring target still needs a bounded pedal-safe implementation. Hardware untested.
fxid_comment: 0x0392. Was 409 until 2026-10-29, which TEcho4.ZDL (repeat98/ZoomMultistompZDL) also used: swapping the two froze an MS-70CDR at boot. 914 is used by no collection in any group.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: BPM source for synced delay times. Descriptor is marked with the stock tempo flag pattern; true tap-tempo host writes still need hardware proof.

params.name: Div
params.comment: Discrete musical division selector inside the DSP: 1/16, 1/8T, 1/8, dotted 1/8, 1/4, dotted 1/4.

params.name: Feed
params.comment: Progressive repeats through 80; loop coefficient crosses unity near 92, reaching 1.4 at 100. Actual sustain depends on Wear, Drive and signal spectrum; record saturation bounds the loop.

params.name: Wear
params.comment: Adds aged-tape filtering around the fixed Galaxy-derived head/tape FIR response.

params.name: Drive
params.comment: TapeHack-style soft clipping into the record path.

params.name: Spring
params.comment: Experimental parallel mono spring-reverb return. Disabled by default while a closer Galaxy model is developed.
